author: EvilPoet_69
quote:
Can't believe this was on the making 13 years:

Cons:

- No physical
- 30 fps if locked could be okish? but dropping into the 20s?
- Bugs every 20 minutes
- Fearing my save files will be deleted 
- Mid Story line
- Repetitive mechanics
- RDR 2 clearly superior
- I feel Scammed and can't keep interest for longer than 1 hr sessions
- Asked for a refund and was denied
- Press giving 100 score to such an unpolished game? Example: 
"Crimson Desert has no story, so much to do in the world takes the attention away from the plot" VS. " GTA 6 has so much to do I haven't even done the story" 
"cyberpunk is full of bugs a shame to the industry" VS. "GTA 6 is not perfect, still give it a 100"

Pros:

- Graphics are nice I guess, Rage engine is cool. Sad it was released on poor hardware. 

Will give it a shot again when it's on PC (maybe)

author: EvilPoet_69
quote: An absolute master piece all over again! Almost 30 years later it comes back to show not only quality of life implementations but a ridiculously huge attention and care for detail. This is the most romantic love letter to Ocarina of time we always wished for. Thank you Nintendo !
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
